title: crypto2dev_kpp.c: register ECDH (P-256, P-384) and DH
description: Register three key-agreement algorithms as kernel kpp (key-protocol-primitive) algorithms: ecdh-nist-p256, ecdh-nist-p384, and dh. Implement .set_secret (parse the kernel kpp secret blob), .generate_public_key (wc_ecc_make_key for ECDH, wc_DhGenerateKeyPair for DH), .compute_shared_secret (wc_ecc_shared_secret for ECDH, wc_DhAgree for DH). Kernel kpp secret blob format: struct kpp_secret header + raw key bytes — parse with the kpp helper functions.
design: Read include/crypto/kpp.h and include/crypto/ecdh.h carefully before writing. The kernel ECDH API uses a specific secret blob encoding (struct ecdh from include/crypto/ecdh.h). DH parameters (p, g) come from the secret blob for DH or are fixed for ECDH. FIPS-approved curves only: P-256, P-384. See DESIGN.md §kpp.
